content:
NESTS / CBSE has published official result and examination-service links for the EMRS ESSE-2025 Teaching / Non-Teaching recruitment process, including the Tier-II Principal result workflow.

Use the official examination-services login to download the Tier-II result or scorecard. The NESTS result notice and final answer-key links provide the authoritative status and next-stage instructions.

How to check the result

  1. Open the official Tier-II Principal result login.
  2. Sign in with the application credentials.
  3. Download or view the result / scorecard.
  4. Read the NESTS notice for skill test, interview, document verification and medical requirements applicable to your post.

Selection stages

The recruitment process may include written examination, skill or practical test, interview where required, document verification and medical examination according to the post. Follow only the stage mentioned in the official notice for your post.
